definitions.captured_command_output_bytes: Sum of UTF-8 byte lengths of command_execution aggregated_output in completed CLI events; includes listings, retrieval, and local verification output, not necessarily all bytes shown to the model.
definitions.usage: Codex turn.completed accounting; input includes cached input. Output includes reasoning; no price or quota conversion is inferred.
definitions.oversized: A captured command result above 20,000 bytes is an output-volume diagnostic, not a correctness failure. CLI JSON does not expose a per-call model-visible token cap.
definitions.truncation: Substring diagnostic only; zero markers does not prove every tool response reached the model untruncated.
definitions.file_changes: Completed CLI file_change events; decision and final response files also preserved directly.
